tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba bzhugs so// rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba mang yang / 'di yum ka'i 'pho ba la/ gzhan du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas byas kyang chog gtso cher mngon rtogs kyi mjug bsam mi khyab kyi mthar/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi bo'i tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar du rtsa dbu ma drang tha le ba lcags tsam yar rim bzhin spom du song ba rtse mo tshangs bug tu rgya mthongs kha phye ba ltar har re yod pa/ de'i steng du bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ mtha' skor du mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin ltar gtib pa tsam gyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs bla ma la thim/ rang gi lte bar dbu ma'i mas sna ru chos 'byung nang du rnam shes baṃ yig du bsam/ lus longs spyod mchod par 'bul bar bsam te/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ spro na rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ de tsam ma byung na 'di ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag 'dzin blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshungs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ 'og rlung 'then tsam byas hika zhes brjod pas rang sems kyi ngo bo baṃ yig de dbu ma'i nang nas yar rgya mthongs la bya 'phur ba bzhin song / bla ma'i thugs khar thim par bsam la cung zad glod la bzhag yang bla ma'i thugs kha nas thon te dbu ma nas mar zhugs/ dbu ma'i mas sna chos 'byung gi nang du slebs par bsams la ngag tu ka zhes brjod yang sngar ltar mchod bstod gsol btab byas la bla ma'i thugs khar 'pho/

yang mar 'bebs pa sogs thun ri'i nang du tshar ci 'gro byed/ thun bsdu ba na/ mtha' skor gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bla ma la thim/ bla ma spyi gtsug nas snying khar byon/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug 'od dmar gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyis bkab chu yang mi 'dzag rlung yang mi thar bar bsam/ rtags ma byung bar du sbyangs te/ rtags ni spyi gtsug skrangs pa dang / khrag thon pa/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa 'byung / las sbyor ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe bla ma'i thugs khar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad bar du yang yang bya/ mthar bla ma skar mda' 'pho ba ltar rang gang du mos pa'i zhing khams su gshegs par bsam pa'o/ /'pho ba gnad du song na bar dor mkha' spyod 'grub gsung ngo / /zhes pa 'di'ang bskul ba'i ngor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bres pa'o// //mad+ga laṃ/ dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
